voice: Confident, energetic male fitness coach, punchy and clear, short pauses.
music: Upbeat energetic electronic workout track for a fitness app reel. Punchy four-on-the-floor drums, bright synth plucks, driving bass, confident and motivational, steady 118 BPM, builds slightly, about 60 seconds, clean ending.

script.intro: Slouching steals inches. Train the muscles that hold you tall.

clips.shot: Full body from behind at a 3/4 angle, standing tall, both arms raised in a Y shape overhead, shoulder blades squeezed; upper back glows
clips.move: standing Y-raises, arms rising overhead in a Y and lowering
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right

clips.shot: Medium shot from behind and slightly above, head to hips, wall-angel style reverse snow angel with elbows bent at 90 degrees; rhomboids glow intensely
clips.move: reverse snow angels, elbows sliding up and down while the shoulder blades squeeze

clips.shot: Wide side view, forearm plank on a black mat, body in a perfectly straight line; abs glow. Figure in the lower-middle of the frame
clips.move: a steady forearm plank with slow breathing
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right

clips.shot: High angle from beside the hips, lying on the back on a black mat doing a dead bug, opposite arm and leg extended; abs glow
clips.move: dead bugs, opposite arm and leg extending and returning

clips.shot: Wide side view, glute bridge on a black mat, hips lifted to a straight line from knees to shoulders; glutes glow. Figure in the lower-middle of the frame
clips.move: glute bridges, hips rising and lowering

clips.shot: Low rear 3/4 view, single-leg glute bridge with one leg extended; glutes glow intensely
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right

clips.shot: Full body side view, bodyweight single-leg Romanian deadlift, torso hinged forward, back leg straight behind; hamstrings glow
clips.move: single-leg Romanian deadlifts, hinging forward and standing tall

clips.shot: Side view, seated on a black mat, legs straight, reaching toward the toes with a long flat back; hamstrings glow
clips.move: a seated hamstring stretch, reaching forward and easing back

clips.shot: Side view, bird dog on all fours on a black mat, opposite arm and leg extended level; spinal erectors glow
clips.move: bird dogs, opposite arm and leg extending and returning
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right

clips.shot: Rear 3/4 view from above, lying face down on a black mat in a superman hold, arms and legs lifted; the whole back glows
clips.move: superman lifts, arms and legs rising and lowering
